return table.freeze({
 Protocol=1, GlobalEnabled=true, ApprovedUniverseId=10769217377,
 PollSeconds=5, TicketTTL=45, MatchTTL=180, AllocationSeconds=30,
 MaxTickets=32, MaxMatches=8, MaxSearchSeconds=600,
 RegionRelaxSeconds=90, PingSpread=80, ArrivalMaxPingMs=450,
 Modes=table.freeze({'1v1','2v2','3v3','4v4'}),
})

--!nonstrict
-- Pure transaction model. No yielding, remotes, clocks, random calls or cloud access.
local M={}
function M.Copy(v)
 if type(v)~='table'then return v end
 local out={};for k,x in pairs(v)do out[k]=M.Copy(x)end;return out
end
function M.Empty()return {Tickets={},Matches={}}end
function M.Prune(s,now)
 for id,m in pairs(s.Matches)do if now>=m.ExpiresAt then s.Matches[id]=nil end end
 for id,t in pairs(s.Tickets)do
  if now>=t.ExpiresAt or t.Match and not s.Matches[t.Match]then s.Tickets[id]=nil end
 end
end
function M.Add(s,t,c,now)
 if s.Tickets[t.Id]then return false,'AlreadyQueued'end
 local n=0;local ids={};for _,v in ipairs(t.Members)do if ids[v]then return false,'DuplicatePlayer'end;ids[v]=true end
 for _,existing in pairs(s.Tickets)do n+=1;for _,id in ipairs(existing.Members)do if ids[id]then return false,'AlreadyQueued'end end end
 if n>=c.MaxTickets then return false,'QueueFull'end
 s.Tickets[t.Id]=M.Copy(t);s.Tickets[t.Id].ExpiresAt=now+c.TicketTTL;return true
end
function M.Cancel(s,id,job)
 local t=s.Tickets[id];if not t then return true end
 if t.Job~=job then return false,'Forbidden'end
 if t.Match then return false,'MatchFound'end
 s.Tickets[id]=nil;return true
end
function M.Heartbeat(s,id,job,now,c)
 local t=s.Tickets[id];if not t or t.Job~=job then return false end
 t.ExpiresAt=now+(t.Match and c.MatchTTL or c.TicketTTL);return true
end
local function compatible(a,b,now,c)
 if now-math.min(a.CreatedAt,b.CreatedAt)>=c.RegionRelaxSeconds then return true end
 return a.Region==b.Region and math.abs(a.Ping-b.Ping)<=c.PingSpread
end
-- Bounded dynamic programming (at most 25 states for 4v4), never split a ticket.
function M.Select(s,size,now,c)
 local list={};for _,t in pairs(s.Tickets)do if not t.Match and t.ExpiresAt>now and #t.Members<=size then table.insert(list,t)end end
 table.sort(list,function(a,b)return a.CreatedAt==b.CreatedAt and a.Id<b.Id or a.CreatedAt<b.CreatedAt end)
 for _,anchor in ipairs(list)do
  local dp={['0:0']={Red={},Blue={}}}
  for _,t in ipairs(list)do if compatible(anchor,t,now,c)then
   local nextDP=table.clone(dp)
   for key,teams in pairs(dp)do
    local r,b=key:match('(%d+):(%d+)');r=tonumber(r);b=tonumber(b)
    for _,side in ipairs({'Red','Blue'})do
     local nr=r+(side=='Red'and #t.Members or 0);local nb=b+(side=='Blue'and #t.Members or 0)
     local k=nr..':'..nb
     if nr<=size and nb<=size and not nextDP[k]then
      local selected={Red=table.clone(teams.Red),Blue=table.clone(teams.Blue)}
      table.insert(selected[side],t.Id);nextDP[k]=selected
     end
    end
   end
   dp=nextDP
  end end
  if dp[size..':'..size]then return dp[size..':'..size]end
 end
end
function M.Assign(s,id,mode,size,job,now,c)
 local count=0;for _ in pairs(s.Matches)do count+=1 end;if count>=c.MaxMatches then return end
 local teams=M.Select(s,size,now,c);if not teams then return end
 local m={Id=id,Mode=mode,Size=size,Owner=job,State='Allocating',CreatedAt=now,ExpiresAt=now+c.MatchTTL,AllocateUntil=now+c.AllocationSeconds,Red={},Blue={},Parties={}}
 for _,side in ipairs({'Red','Blue'})do for _,key in ipairs(teams[side])do
  local t=s.Tickets[key];t.Match=id;t.ExpiresAt=m.ExpiresAt
  table.insert(m.Parties,M.Copy(t));for _,uid in ipairs(t.Members)do table.insert(m[side],uid)end
 end end
 s.Matches[id]=m;return m
end
function M.Fail(s,id,reason)
 local m=s.Matches[id];if m and m.State~='Running'then m.State='Failed';m.Reason=reason end
end
function M.IsMember(m,id)
 return table.find(m.Red,id)~=nil or table.find(m.Blue,id)~=nil
end
function M.ValidArrival(m,id,privateId,now)
 return m~=nil and m.State=='Ready'and m.ExpiresAt>now and m.PrivateId==privateId and M.IsMember(m,id)
end
return M

--!nonstrict
local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local Run=game:GetService('RunService')
local Http=game:GetService('HttpService')
local Config=require(RS.Shared.PartyMatchConfig)
local Model=require(script.Parent.Gameplay.PartyQueueModel)
local Store=require(script.Parent.Gameplay.PartyQueueStore)
local Service={Name='PartyMatchService'}
local function now()return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()end
local function guid()return Http:GenerateGUID(false)end
local function connected(id)return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)end
local function ensure(parent,name,class)
 local o=parent:FindFirstChild(name);if o then assert(o:IsA(class));return o end
 o=Instance.new(class);o.Name=name;o.Parent=parent;return o
end
function Service:Init(context)
 self.Context=context;self.Social=context:GetService('SocialPlayService');self.Rounds=context:GetService('RoundService')
 self.MM=context:GetService('MatchmakingService');self.Profiles=context:GetService('PlayerService')
 local info=context.PersistenceInfo
 self.Global=not Run:IsStudio()and Config.GlobalEnabled and game.GameId==Config.ApprovedUniverseId
  and info and info.Environment=='Production'and info.WritesToCloud==true or false
 self.Enabled=Run:IsStudio()and info and info.ProviderName=='InMemory'and info.WritesToCloud==false or self.Global
 self.Job=game.JobId~=''and game.JobId or guid();self.Store=Store.new(self.Global,'PartyMatchV1_'..game.PlaceId)
 self.Tickets={};self.Regions={};self.Last={};self.Busy={};self.Grants={};self.PendingArrivals={};self.Arrivals={};self.ArrivalLoading={};self.Returning={};self.ReturnGroups={}
 self.IsReserved=self.Global and game.PrivateServerId~=''and game.PrivateServerOwnerId==0
 local folder=ensure(RS.Remotes,'PartyMatch','Folder');self.Remote=ensure(folder,'Request','RemoteFunction');self.Updated=ensure(folder,'Updated','RemoteEvent')
end
function Service:Available(p,ownTicket)
 if not p or p.Parent~=Players or not self.Profiles:IsShopDataReady(p)then return false end
 if self.Rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(p)or p:GetAttribute('ResultsSessionId')or p:GetAttribute('TrainingSessionId')then return false end
 local lock=p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket');if lock and lock~=ownTicket then return false end
 if self.MM:IsPlayerOnPhysicalQueue(p)then return false end
 local trade=self.Context:GetService('SocialService');if trade and trade.Engine and trade.Engine.Busy[p.UserId]then return false end
 local h=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');return h~=nil and h.Health>0
end
function Service:State(p)
 local id=p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket');local t=id and self.Tickets[id]
 return {Ok=true,Enabled=self.Enabled==true,Global=self.Global,State=t and t.State or self.IsReserved and 'Destination'or 'Idle',Mode=t and t.Mode,
  Since=t and t.Since or 0,Leader=t and t.Leader,CanCancel=t and t.State=='Searching'and t.Leader==p.UserId or false,
  CanReturn=self.IsReserved and not self.Rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(p)and not self.PendingArrivals[p.UserId]and not self.Destination,
  Server=Run:IsStudio()and 'Studio' or self.Job:sub(1,8),Version=game.PlaceVersion,Region='Región del servidor no disponible'}
end
function Service:Push(t,reason)
 for _,id in ipairs(t.Members)do local p=connected(id);if p then local s=self:State(p);s.Reason=reason;self.Updated:FireClient(p,s)end end
end
function Service:Unlock(t,reason)
 if self.Tickets[t.Id]~=t then return end
 local removed=pcall(function()self.Store:Update(t.Mode,function(s)
  local row=s.Tickets[t.Id];if row and row.Job==self.Job then s.Tickets[t.Id]=nil end
 end)end)
 if not removed then return end
 self.Tickets[t.Id]=nil
 for _,id in ipairs(t.Members)do local p=connected(id);if p and p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket')==t.Id then p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil)end end
 self:Push(t,reason)
end
function Service:Join(p,mode)
 if not self.Enabled or self.IsReserved then return {Ok=false,Reason='Unavailable'}end
 if not table.find(Config.Modes,mode)or not self.Rounds:IsModePlayable(mode)then return {Ok=false,Reason='ModeUnavailable'}end
 local size=tonumber(mode:sub(1,1));local group=self.Social.Engine:Group(p.UserId)
 if group and group.Leader~=p.UserId then return {Ok=false,Reason='NotLeader'}end
 local members=group and table.clone(group.Members)or {p.UserId}
 if #members>size then return {Ok=false,Reason='GroupTooLarge'}end
 local ping=0;local region
 for _,id in ipairs(members)do local member=connected(id)
  if not self:Available(member)or self.Social.Engine.Busy[id]then return {Ok=false,Reason='PlayerUnavailable'}end
  local ok,value=pcall(member.GetNetworkPing,member);ping=math.max(ping,ok and value*1000 or 0)
  local r=self.Regions[id]or 'Unknown';region=region and(region==r and r or 'Mixed')or r
 end
 local id=guid();local t={Id=id,Mode=mode,Leader=p.UserId,Members=members,Job=self.Job,CreatedAt=now(),Since=now(),Region=region,Ping=ping,State='Searching'}
 self.Tickets[id]=t;for _,uid in ipairs(members)do connected(uid):SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',id)end
 local ok,state=pcall(function()return self.Store:Update(mode,function(s)Model.Prune(s,now());Model.Add(s,t,Config,now())end)end)
 if not ok or not state.Tickets[id]then self:Unlock(t,'QueueUnavailable');return {Ok=false,Reason='QueueUnavailable'}end
 self:Push(t);return self:State(p)
end
function Service:Cancel(p)
 local t=self.Tickets[p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket')];if not t then return self:State(p)end
 if t.Leader~=p.UserId then return {Ok=false,Reason='NotLeader'}end
 local ok,s=pcall(function()return self.Store:Update(t.Mode,function(state)Model.Cancel(state,t.Id,self.Job)end)end)
 if not ok then return {Ok=false,Reason='QueueUnavailable'}end
 if s.Tickets[t.Id]then return {Ok=false,Reason='MatchFound'}end
 self:Unlock(t,'Cancelled');return self:State(p)
end
function Service:Abort(t,reason)
 local ok=pcall(function()self.Store:Update(t.Mode,function(s)
  local row=s.Tickets[t.Id];if row and row.Match then Model.Fail(s,row.Match,reason)end
  s.Tickets[t.Id]=nil
 end)end)
 if ok or now()-t.Since>Config.MaxSearchSeconds+Config.TicketTTL then self:Unlock(t,reason)end
end
function Service:ValidateReservation(token,request)
 local g=self.Grants[token];if not g or g.Consumed or now()>=g.ExpiresAt or g.ZoneId~=request.ZoneId or g.Mode~=request.Mode or g.Size~=request.TeamSize then return false,'InvalidMenuReservation'end
 for _,side in ipairs({'RedTeam','BlueTeam'})do
  if #g[side]~=#request[side]then return false,'InvalidRoster'end
  for i,p in ipairs(g[side])do if p~=request[side][i]or p.Parent~=Players then return false,'InvalidRoster'end end
 end
 return true
end
function Service:ConsumeReservation(token)local g=self.Grants[token];if not g or g.Consumed then return false end;g.Consumed=true;return true end
function Service:Prepared(zone,red,blue)
 for _,g in pairs(self.Grants)do if g.ZoneId==zone and g.Consumed then
  for _,side in ipairs({{g.RedTeam,red},{g.BlueTeam,blue}})do if #side[1]~=#side[2]then return false end
   for i,p in ipairs(side[1])do local s=self.Rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(p);if side[2][i]~=p or not s or s.ZoneId~=zone or s.Closing then return false end end
  end;return true
 end end;return false
end
function Service:Release(zone,token)local g=self.Grants[token];if g and g.ZoneId==zone then self.Grants[token]=nil end end
function Service:StartMatch(m)
 local g={ZoneId='Menu:'..m.Id,Mode=m.Mode,Size=m.Size,ExpiresAt=now()+120,RedTeam={},BlueTeam={}}
 for _,side in ipairs({'Red','Blue'})do for _,id in ipairs(m[side])do
  local p=connected(id);if not self:Available(p,p and p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket'))then return false,'PlayerUnavailable'end
  table.insert(g[side..'Team'],p)
 end end
 local token=guid();self.Grants[token]=g
 local ok,started,why=pcall(self.Rounds.StartTeamMatch,self.Rounds,{ZoneId=g.ZoneId,Mode=g.Mode,TeamSize=g.Size,RedTeam=g.RedTeam,BlueTeam=g.BlueTeam,ReservationToken=token})
 if not ok or not started then self.Grants[token]=nil;return false,ok and why or 'StartFailed'end
 return true
end
function Service:RestoreParties(m)
 local e=self.Social.Engine
 for _,t in ipairs(m.Parties)do
  if #t.Members>1 then
   for _,id in ipairs(t.Members)do if e:Group(id)then return false end end
  end
 end
 for _,t in ipairs(m.Parties)do if #t.Members>1 then
  local g={Id=guid(),Leader=t.Leader,Members=table.clone(t.Members),Revision=0};e.Groups[g.Id]=g;e:_publish(g)
 end end;return true
end
function Service:Teleport(t,m)
 if t.State=='Teleporting'then return end
 t.State='Teleporting';t.Match=m.Id;self:Push(t)
 local list={};for _,id in ipairs(t.Members)do local p=connected(id);if not self:Available(p,t.Id)then self:Abort(t,'PlayerUnavailable');return end;table.insert(list,p)end
 local options=Instance.new('TeleportOptions');options.ReservedServerAccessCode=m.AccessCode
 options:SetTeleportData({PartyMatchV1={Id=m.Id,Mode=m.Mode}})
 local ok=pcall(function()game:GetService('TeleportService'):TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId,list,options)end)
 if not ok then self:Abort(t,'TeleportFailed')end
end
function Service:PollMode(mode)
 local timestamp=now();local candidateId=guid();local size=tonumber(mode:sub(1,1))
 local state=self.Store:Update(mode,function(s)
  Model.Prune(s,timestamp)
  for _,t in pairs(self.Tickets)do if t.Mode==mode then Model.Heartbeat(s,t.Id,self.Job,timestamp,Config)end end
  for _,m in pairs(s.Matches)do if m.State=='Allocating'and timestamp>=m.AllocateUntil then Model.Fail(s,m.Id,'ReservationTimeout')end end
  if self.Global or self.Rounds:IsAvailable()then Model.Assign(s,candidateId,mode,size,self.Job,timestamp,Config)end
 end)
 for _,m in pairs(state.Matches)do if m.Owner==self.Job and m.State=='Allocating'then
  if self.Global then
   local ok,access,privateId=pcall(function()return game:GetService('TeleportService'):ReserveServerAsync(game.PlaceId)end)
   state=self.Store:Update(mode,function(s)
    local current=s.Matches[m.Id]
    if current and current.State=='Allocating'and now()<current.AllocateUntil then
     if ok then current.State='Ready';current.AccessCode=access;current.PrivateId=privateId else Model.Fail(s,m.Id,'ReservationFailed')end
    end
   end)
  else
   local ok,why=self:StartMatch(m)
   state=self.Store:Update(mode,function(s)local row=s.Matches[m.Id];if row then row.State=ok and 'Running'or 'Failed';row.Reason=why end end)
  end
 end end
 for _,t in pairs(table.clone(self.Tickets))do if t.Mode==mode then
  local row=state.Tickets[t.Id];local m=row and row.Match and state.Matches[row.Match]
  if not row then self:Unlock(t,'QueueExpired')
  elseif m and m.State=='Failed'then self:Unlock(t,m.Reason)
  elseif m and m.State=='Running'then self:Unlock(t)
  elseif m then
   t.Match=m.Id
   if m.State=='Ready'and self.Global then self:Teleport(t,m)
   elseif t.State~='Teleporting'then t.State='Matched';self:Push(t)end
  else self:Push(t)end
 end end
end
function Service:LoadArrival(p)
 if self.ArrivalLoading[p]or self.Arrivals[p]then return end;self.ArrivalLoading[p]=true
 local ok,join=pcall(p.GetJoinData,p);local payload=ok and join.TeleportData and join.TeleportData.PartyMatchV1
 if not payload or type(payload.Id)~='string'or #payload.Id>64 or not table.find(Config.Modes,payload.Mode)or join.SourcePlaceId~=game.PlaceId then
  self.PendingArrivals[p.UserId]=nil;p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil);self.Arrivals[p]=true;self.ArrivalLoading[p]=nil;return
 end
 local loaded,s=pcall(function()return self.Store:Read(payload.Mode)end)
 local m=loaded and s and s.Matches[payload.Id]
 if not loaded then self.ArrivalLoading[p]=nil;return end
 if not Model.ValidArrival(m,p.UserId,game.PrivateServerId,now())then
  self.PendingArrivals[p.UserId]=nil;p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil);self.Arrivals[p]=true;self.ArrivalLoading[p]=nil;return
 end
 if self.Destination and self.Destination.Id~=m.Id then self.PendingArrivals[p.UserId]=nil;p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil);self.Arrivals[p]=true;self.ArrivalLoading[p]=nil;return end
 self.Destination=self.Destination or m
 self.Arrivals[p]=true;self.ArrivalLoading[p]=nil
 p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket','Arrival:'..m.Id)
end
function Service:DestinationTick()
 if not self.Destination then return end
 local m=self.Destination;local state=self.Store:Read(m.Mode);local current=state and state.Matches[m.Id]
 if not current or current.State=='Failed'or now()>=m.ExpiresAt then self:FinishDestination('ArrivalFailed');return end
 local all=true
 for _,side in ipairs({'Red','Blue'})do for _,id in ipairs(m[side])do
  local p=connected(id)
  if not p or not self.Arrivals[p]or not self:Available(p,'Arrival:'..m.Id)then all=false end
 end end
 if not all then return end
 -- Verify actual latency at the destination rather than treating source ping as a guarantee.
 for _,side in ipairs({'Red','Blue'})do for _,id in ipairs(m[side])do
  if connected(id):GetNetworkPing()*1000>Config.ArrivalMaxPingMs then
   self.Store:Update(m.Mode,function(s)Model.Fail(s,m.Id,'DestinationLatency')end);self:FinishDestination('DestinationLatency');return
  end
 end end
 local committed=self.Store:Update(m.Mode,function(s)
  local row=s.Matches[m.Id]
  if row and row.State=='Ready'and not row.ConsumerJob then row.ConsumerJob=self.Job;row.State='Starting'end
 end)
 local row=committed.Matches[m.Id]
 if not row or row.ConsumerJob~=self.Job or row.State~='Starting'then self:FinishDestination('DestinationUnavailable');return end
 local ok,why=false,'PartyRestoreFailed'
 if self:RestoreParties(row)then ok,why=self:StartMatch(row)end
 self.Store:Update(m.Mode,function(s)local r=s.Matches[m.Id];if r and r.ConsumerJob==self.Job then r.State=ok and 'Running'or 'Failed';r.Reason=why end end)
 self:FinishDestination(ok and nil or why)
end
function Service:FinishDestination(reason)
 self.Destination=nil
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do self.PendingArrivals[p.UserId]=nil;p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil)
  local s=self:State(p);s.Reason=reason;self.Updated:FireClient(p,s)
 end
end
function Service:Return(p)
 if not self:State(p).CanReturn or self.Returning[p]then return {Ok=false,Reason='PlayerUnavailable'}end
 local g=self.Social.Engine:Group(p.UserId);if g and g.Leader~=p.UserId then return {Ok=false,Reason='NotLeader'}end
 local members=g and g.Members or {p.UserId};local list={}
 for _,id in ipairs(members)do local q=connected(id);if not q or not self:State(q).CanReturn then return {Ok=false,Reason='PlayerUnavailable'}end;table.insert(list,q)end
 for _,q in ipairs(list)do self.Returning[q]=true end
 local ok=pcall(function()
  local key='Return_'..guid();local data={Members=table.clone(members),Leader=p.UserId,ExpiresAt=now()+Config.MatchTTL}
  self.Store:Update(key,function(s)s.Return=data end)
  local options=Instance.new('TeleportOptions');options:SetTeleportData({PartyReturnV1=key})
  game:GetService('TeleportService'):TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId,list,options)
 end)
 if not ok then for _,q in ipairs(list)do self.Returning[q]=nil end end
 return {Ok=ok,Reason=not ok and 'TeleportFailed'or nil}
end
function Service:LoadReturn(p)
 local join=p:GetJoinData();local key=join.TeleportData and join.TeleportData.PartyReturnV1
 if join.SourcePlaceId~=game.PlaceId or type(key)~='string'or #key>64 or key:sub(1,7)~='Return_'then return end
 p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',key)
 local ok,s=pcall(function()return self.Store:Update(key,function(state)
  local r=state.Return;if r and r.ExpiresAt>now()and table.find(r.Members,p.UserId)and(not r.Job or r.Job==self.Job)then r.Job=self.Job end
 end)end)
 local r=ok and s.Return
 if r and r.ExpiresAt>now()and r.Job==self.Job and table.find(r.Members,p.UserId)then self.ReturnGroups[key]=r
 else p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil)end
end
function Service:ReturnTick()
 for key,r in pairs(self.ReturnGroups)do
  local ready=true;for _,id in ipairs(r.Members)do local p=connected(id);if not p or not self:Available(p,key)then ready=false end end
  if ready or now()>=r.ExpiresAt then
   if ready then self:RestoreParties({Parties={r}})end
   for _,id in ipairs(r.Members)do local p=connected(id);if p and p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket')==key then p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil)end end
   self.ReturnGroups[key]=nil
   self.Store:Update(key,function(s)s.Return=nil end)
  end
 end
end
function Service:Request(p,action,arg)
 if self.Busy[p]or now()-(self.Last[p]or 0)<.4 then return {Ok=false,Reason='RateLimited'}end
 self.Last[p]=now();self.Busy[p]=true
 local ok,r=pcall(function()
  if action=='State'then return self:State(p)
  elseif action=='Join'and type(arg)=='string'then return self:Join(p,arg)
  elseif action=='Cancel'then return self:Cancel(p)
  elseif action=='Return'then return self:Return(p)end
  return {Ok=false,Reason='InvalidRequest'}
 end)
 self.Busy[p]=nil;if not ok then warn('[PartyMatch] Request failed: '..tostring(r));return {Ok=false,Reason='QueueUnavailable'}end;return r
end
function Service:Start()
 self.Remote.OnServerInvoke=function(...)return self:Request(...)end
 if not self.Enabled then return end
 local function added(p)
  if self.IsReserved then self.PendingArrivals[p.UserId]=now();p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket','ArrivalPending');task.spawn(function()self:LoadArrival(p)end)
  elseif self.Global then task.spawn(function()
   local returned,err=pcall(self.LoadReturn,self,p);if not returned then p:SetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket',nil);warn('[PartyMatch] Return validation failed: '..tostring(err))end
   local ok,r=pcall(function()return game:GetService('LocalizationService'):GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(p)end)
   if ok and p.Parent==Players then self.Regions[p.UserId]=r end
  end)end
 end
 Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(added);for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do added(p)end
 Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
  local t=self.Tickets[p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket')];if t and t.State~='Teleporting'then task.spawn(function()self:Abort(t,'Disconnected')end)end
  self.Last[p]=nil;self.Busy[p]=nil;self.Arrivals[p]=nil;self.ArrivalLoading[p]=nil;self.Regions[p.UserId]=nil;self.Returning[p]=nil
 end)
 if self.Global then game:GetService('TeleportService').TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(p,_,_,_,options)
  self.Returning[p]=nil
  local data=options and options:GetTeleportData();local id=data and data.PartyMatchV1 and data.PartyMatchV1.Id
  local t=self.Tickets[p:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket')]
  if t and t.Match==id then task.spawn(function()self:Abort(t,'TeleportFailed')end)end
 end)end
 task.spawn(function()while true do
  task.wait(Config.PollSeconds)
  local ok,err=pcall(function()

-- Gestiona la detección de jugadores en zonas de matchmaking genéricas (1v1, 2v2, 3v3),

-- partidas hacia RoundService.
-- La instancia física (zoneFolder) es la identidad primaria interna de la zona.
-- NO se encarga de efectos audiovisuales (delegado a MatchmakingFeedbackService)
-- ni de la presentación visual del HUD (delegado a MatchmakingController).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)

type QueueSnapshot = Types.QueueSnapshot
type MatchmakingZoneConfig = Types.MatchmakingZoneConfig
type QueueStateName = Types.QueueStateName

export type ZoneData = {
	ZoneId: string,
	Instance: Folder,
	ZoneName: string,
	Config: MatchmakingZoneConfig,
	RedPads: { BasePart },
	BluePads: { BasePart },
	PadOccupants: { [BasePart]: { Player } },
	OccupantLastSeen: { [Player]: number },
	CandidateArrivals: { [Player]: number },
	CandidateLastSeen: { [Player]: number },

-- Obtiene el Player asociado a una parte de un personaje
local function getPlayerFromPart(part: BasePart): Player?
	local current: Instance? = part
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		if current:IsA("Model") then
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current)
			if player then
				return player
			end
			if MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap and MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap[current] then
				return MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap[current]
			end
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT = 6.0
local OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD = 0.8 -- Segundos de gracia para tolerar saltos y fluctuaciones espaciales

-- Valida si un jugador está conectado, con personaje instanciado en workspace y Humanoid vivo
local function isPlayerAliveAndValid(player: any): boolean
	local isRealPlayer = typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") and player:IsDescendantOf(Players)
	local isSimulated = typeof(player) == "table" and player.IsSimulatedPlayer == true
	if not isRealPlayer and not isSimulated then return false end
	if isRealPlayer and player:GetAttribute('PartyQueueTicket') then return false end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return true
end

-- Detecta los jugadores físicos dentro del volumen de un pad usando GetPartBoundsInBox
local function getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad: BasePart, overlapParams: OverlapParams): { Player }
	local boxCFrame = pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (pad.Size.Y / 2) + (PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT / 2), 0)
	local boxSize = Vector3.new(pad.Size.X, PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT, pad.Size.Z)
	local touchingParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, boxSize, overlapParams)

	local presentList: { Player } = {}
	local seen: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

	for _, part in ipairs(touchingParts) do
		local player = getPlayerFromPart(part)
		if player and not seen[player] then
			if isPlayerAliveAndValid(player) then
				seen[player] = true
				table.insert(presentList, player)
			end
		end
	end

	return presentList
end

-- Actualiza autoritativamente la ocupación de un conjunto de pads (equipo) aplicando
-- prioridad por orden de llegada (FIFO), reserva por plaza, grace period y prevención de doble ocupación.
local function updateTeamOccupants(
	zone: ZoneData,
	pads: { BasePart },
	maxTeamCapacity: number,
	otherTeamOccupantsSet: { [Player]: boolean },
	overlapParams: OverlapParams,
	now: number,
	service: any
): { Player }
	if #pads == 0 or maxTeamCapacity <= 0 then
		return {}
	end

	local padCapacity = math.max(1, math.ceil(maxTeamCapacity / #pads))

	-- 1. Detección física en cada pad del equipo
	local presentByPad: { [BasePart]: { [Player]: boolean } } = {}
	local allPresentOnTeam: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local presentList = getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad, overlapParams)
		local padSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(presentList) do
			padSet[p] = true
			allPresentOnTeam[p] = true
		end
		presentByPad[pad] = padSet
	end

	-- 2. Retención de ocupantes existentes (con grace period)
	local assignedThisTeam: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	local teamOccupantsList: { Player } = {}

	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local currentOccupants = zone.PadOccupants[pad] or {}
		local retained: { Player } = {}
		local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}

		for _, occupant in ipairs(currentOccupants) do
			if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(occupant) then
				-- Jugador muerto o desconectado: liberación inmediata sin periodo de gracia
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
			elseif assignedThisTeam[occupant] or otherTeamOccupantsSet[occupant] then
				-- Conflicto: ya asignado a otra plaza o al equipo contrario
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
			else
				if presentSet[occupant] then
					-- Físicamente presente: retiene plaza y actualiza marca temporal
					zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = now
					assignedThisTeam[occupant] = true
					table.insert(retained, occupant)
					table.insert(teamOccupantsList, occupant)
				else
					-- Ausente físicamente en este frame: comprobar periodo de gracia (tolerancia a saltos/jitter)
					local lastSeen = zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] or 0
					if (now - lastSeen) <= OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD then
						assignedThisTeam[occupant] = true
						table.insert(retained, occupant)
						table.insert(teamOccupantsList, occupant)
					else
						-- Gracia expirada: abandono confirmado, liberar plaza
						zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
						zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
						zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		zone.PadOccupants[pad] = retained
	end

	-- 3. Registro de candidatos esperando en los pads
	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}
		for p in pairs(presentSet) do
			if not assignedThisTeam[p] and not otherTeamOccupantsSet[p] then
				if not service:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(p, zone) then
					if zone.CandidateArrivals[p] == nil then
						zone.CandidateArrivals[p] = now
					end
					zone.CandidateLastSeen[p] = now
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 4. Asignación de plazas disponibles por orden de llegada (FIFO)
	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local retained = zone.PadOccupants[pad] or {}
		local padSlotsAvailable = padCapacity - #retained
		local teamSlotsAvailable = maxTeamCapacity - #teamOccupantsList

		if padSlotsAvailable > 0 and teamSlotsAvailable > 0 then
			local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}
			local candidates: { Player } = {}

			for p in pairs(presentSet) do
				if not assignedThisTeam[p]
					and not otherTeamOccupantsSet[p]
					and not service:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(p, zone)
					and not table.find(retained, p) then
					table.insert(candidates, p)
				end
			end

			-- Ordenar candidatos por orden de llegada estricto
			table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
				local timeA = zone.CandidateArrivals[a] or math.huge
				local timeB = zone.CandidateArrivals[b] or math.huge
				if timeA == timeB then
					return a.UserId < b.UserId
				end
				return timeA < timeB
			end)

			local toAssign = math.min(padSlotsAvailable, teamSlotsAvailable, #candidates)
			for i = 1, toAssign do
				local chosen = candidates[i]
				table.insert(retained, chosen)
				table.insert(teamOccupantsList, chosen)
				assignedThisTeam[chosen] = true
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[chosen] = now
			end

			zone.PadOccupants[pad] = retained
		end
	end

	-- 5. Limpieza de candidatos que se retiraron (respetando gracia para evitar pérdida por salto)
	for candidate, lastSeen in pairs(zone.CandidateLastSeen) do
		if not allPresentOnTeam[candidate] and not assignedThisTeam[candidate] then
			if (now - lastSeen) > OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD then
				zone.CandidateArrivals[candidate] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[candidate] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	return teamOccupantsList
end

-- Attributes describe an authorized mode; they never define a new mode or its capacity.
local function getZoneConfiguration(zoneFolder: Folder): (MatchmakingZoneConfig?, string?)
	local modeAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("Mode")
	local teamSizeAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("TeamSize")
	local maxPerTeamAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("MaxPlayersPerTeam")
	local totalAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("TotalPlayers")

	local modeName = if type(modeAttr) == "string" and modeAttr ~= "" then modeAttr else zoneFolder.Name
	local configDefaults = Config.Matchmaking and Config.Matchmaking.Modes and Config.Matchmaking.Modes[modeName]

	if not configDefaults then return nil, "UnknownMode" end
	for _, entry in ipairs({
		{ Value = teamSizeAttr, Expected = configDefaults.TeamSize },
		{ Value = maxPerTeamAttr, Expected = configDefaults.MaxPlayersPerTeam },
		{ Value = totalAttr, Expected = configDefaults.TotalPlayers },
	}) do
		if entry.Value ~= nil and entry.Value ~= entry.Expected then
			return nil, "ModeCapacityMismatch"
		end
	end

	return {
		Mode = modeName,
		TeamSize = configDefaults.TeamSize,
		MaxPlayersPerTeam = configDefaults.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
		TotalPlayers = configDefaults.TotalPlayers,
	}
end

-- Verifica si un ZoneId ya está tomado por otra zona activa
function MatchmakingService:_isZoneIdTaken(zoneId: string, currentFolder: Folder): boolean
	for folder, data in pairs(self._zones) do
		if folder ~= currentFolder and data.ZoneId == zoneId then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Verifica si un jugador ya ocupa autoritativamente un pad en otra zona diferente
function MatchmakingService:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(player: Player, currentZone: ZoneData): boolean
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone ~= currentZone then
			if table.find(zone.CurrentRed, player) or table.find(zone.CurrentBlue, player) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function MatchmakingService:Init(context)
	self._context = context
	self._zones = {}
	self._latestSnapshots = {}
	self._containerConnections = {}
	_G.MatchmakingService = self

	-- Garantizar Remote de estado de cola
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local mmFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Matchmaking")
	local queueRemote = mmFolder and mmFolder:FindFirstChild("QueueStatus")
	if queueRemote and queueRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		self._queueStatusRemote = queueRemote
	end

	-- Descubrir zonas en Workspace.ZoneMatchmaking
	local zoneContainer = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneMatchmaking")
	if not zoneContainer then
		warn("[MatchmakingService] No se encontro Workspace.ZoneMatchmaking")
		return
	end

	-- Registrar todas las zonas existentes
	for _, child in ipairs(zoneContainer:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			self:_registerZone(child)
		end
	end

	-- Conectar descubrimiento dinámico en tiempo de ejecución (Runtime Add / Remove)
	table.insert(self._containerConnections, zoneContainer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			-- Dar un frame para asegurar inicialización de atributos y jerarquía en caso de clonación
			task.defer(function()
				if child.Parent == zoneContainer then
					self:_registerZone(child)
				end
			end)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(self._containerConnections, zoneContainer.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			self:_unregisterZone(child)
		end
	end))
end

function MatchmakingService:_registerZone(zoneFolder: Folder)
	if not zoneFolder or not zoneFolder:IsA("Folder") then return end
	if self._zones[zoneFolder] then return end

	local config, configError = getZoneConfiguration(zoneFolder)
	if not config then
		-- Decorative folders have no join pads and are not matchmaking zones.
		if zoneFolder:FindFirstChild("joins-parts") then
			warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': %s", zoneFolder.Name, tostring(configError)))
		end
		return
	end
	local joinsFolder = zoneFolder:FindFirstChild("joins-parts")

	local redPads: { BasePart } = {}
	local bluePads: { BasePart } = {}

	if joinsFolder then
		for _, part in ipairs(joinsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local teamAttr = part:GetAttribute("Team")
				if teamAttr == "Red" or part.Name == "Red" or part.Name:find("Red") then
					table.insert(redPads, part)
				elseif teamAttr == "Blue" or part.Name == "Blue" or part.Name:find("Blue") then
					table.insert(bluePads, part)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #redPads == 0 or #bluePads == 0 then
		warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': MissingTeamPads", zoneFolder.Name))
		return
	end
	table.sort(redPads, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	table.sort(bluePads, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)

	-- Generación de ZoneId único
	local attrId = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("ZoneId")
	local zoneId: string
	if typeof(attrId) == "string" and attrId ~= "" then
		if self:_isZoneIdTaken(attrId, zoneFolder) then
			warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': DuplicateZoneId", zoneFolder.Name))
			return
		end
		zoneId = attrId
	else
		local baseId = "Zone_" .. zoneFolder.Name
		local uniqueId = baseId
		local counter = 1
		while self:_isZoneIdTaken(uniqueId, zoneFolder) do
			counter += 1
			uniqueId = string.format("%s_%d", baseId, counter)
		end
		zoneId = uniqueId
	end

	local padOccupants: { [BasePart]: { Player } } = {}
	for _, pad in ipairs(redPads) do
		padOccupants[pad] = {}
	end
	for _, pad in ipairs(bluePads) do
		padOccupants[pad] = {}
	end

	local zoneData: ZoneData = {
		ZoneId = zoneId,
		Instance = zoneFolder,
		ZoneName = zoneFolder.Name,
		Config = config,
		RedPads = redPads,
		BluePads = bluePads,
		PadOccupants = padOccupants,
		OccupantLastSeen = {},
		CandidateArrivals = {},
		CandidateLastSeen = {},
		CurrentRed = {},
		CurrentBlue = {},
		State = "WAITING",
		ActiveReservation = nil,
		LastModeNotPlayableWarn = nil,
	}

	-- Registrar en MatchmakingFeedbackService
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	if feedbackService then
		feedbackService:RegisterZone(zoneFolder)
	end

	self._zones[zoneFolder] = zoneData
	print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona registrada: '%s' (ZoneId=%s, Modo=%s, TeamSize=%d, MaxTotal=%d)",
		zoneFolder.Name, zoneId, config.Mode, config.TeamSize, config.TotalPlayers))
end

function MatchmakingService:_unregisterZone(zoneFolder: Folder)
	local zoneData = self._zones[zoneFolder]
	if not zoneData then return end

	-- Cleanup en feedback audiovisual
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	if feedbackService then
		feedbackService:UnregisterZone(zoneFolder)
	end

	-- Emitir snapshot vacío final a los clientes si la zona tenía jugadores
	if #zoneData.CurrentRed > 0 or #zoneData.CurrentBlue > 0 then
		if self._queueStatusRemote then
			local finalSnapshot: QueueSnapshot = {
				ZoneId = zoneData.ZoneId,
				ZoneName = zoneData.ZoneName,
				Mode = zoneData.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zoneData.Config.TeamSize,
				MaxPlayersPerTeam = zoneData.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
				TotalPlayers = zoneData.Config.TotalPlayers,
				Red = {},
				Blue = {},
				State = "WAITING",
			}
			self._queueStatusRemote:FireAllClients(finalSnapshot)
		end
	end

	-- Limpieza de caché de snapshots
	self._latestSnapshots[zoneData.ZoneId] = nil
	self._latestSnapshots[zoneData.ZoneName] = nil

	-- Limpieza de tablas de ocupación
	table.clear(zoneData.PadOccupants)
	table.clear(zoneData.OccupantLastSeen)
	table.clear(zoneData.CandidateArrivals)
	table.clear(zoneData.CandidateLastSeen)
	table.clear(zoneData.CurrentRed)
	table.clear(zoneData.CurrentBlue)
	zoneData.ActiveReservation = nil

	self._zones[zoneFolder] = nil
	print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona desregistrada y limpiada: '%s' (ZoneId=%s)",
		zoneFolder.Name, zoneData.ZoneId))
end

-- Limpia de forma inmediata reservas huérfanas al desconectarse un jugador
function MatchmakingService:_handlePlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local needsUpdate = false
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		zone.OccupantLastSeen[player] = nil
		zone.CandidateArrivals[player] = nil
		zone.CandidateLastSeen[player] = nil

		for pad, occupants in pairs(zone.PadOccupants) do
			local idx = table.find(occupants, player)
			if idx then
				table.remove(occupants, idx)
				needsUpdate = true
			end
		end
	end

	if needsUpdate then
		self:_updateQueue()
	end
end

function MatchmakingService:Start(context)
	self._context = context

	-- Monitoreo de ocupación cada 0.3s
	self._checkConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - self._lastCheck < 0.3 then return end
		self._lastCheck = now
		self:_updateQueue()
	end)

	-- Limpieza inmediata cuando un jugador se desconecta del servidor
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_handlePlayerRemoving(player)
	end)

	print("[MatchmakingService] Servicio de matchmaking genérico iniciado")
end

-- Compara si dos listas de jugadores son idénticas
local function arePlayerListsEqual(a: { Player }, b: { Player }): boolean
	if #a ~= #b then return false end
	for i = 1, #a do
		if a[i] ~= b[i] then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function MatchmakingService:_updateQueue()
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	local now = os.clock()

	-- Construir lista de personajes para OverlapParams
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	local characterList = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(characterList, player.Character)
		end
	end
	if self._testCharacterMap then
		for charModel, _ in pairs(self._testCharacterMap) do
			if charModel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				table.insert(characterList, charModel)
			end
		end
	end
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = characterList

	for zoneFolder, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		-- Si la zona fue destruida o desparentada, desregistrar y omitir
		if not zoneFolder or not zoneFolder:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			self:_unregisterZone(zoneFolder)
			continue
		end

		-- Conjunto de ocupantes actuales de Blue para pasárselo a Red
		local currentBlueSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(zone.CurrentBlue) do
			currentBlueSet[p] = true
		end

		local redOccupants = updateTeamOccupants(
			zone,
			zone.RedPads,
			zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
			currentBlueSet,
			overlapParams,
			now,
			self
		)

		-- Conjunto de ocupantes actualizados de Red para pasárselo a Blue
		local currentRedSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(redOccupants) do
			currentRedSet[p] = true
		end

		local blueOccupants = updateTeamOccupants(
			zone,
			zone.BluePads,
			zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
			currentRedSet,
			overlapParams,
			now,
			self
		)

		local redChanged = not arePlayerListsEqual(zone.CurrentRed, redOccupants)
		local blueChanged = not arePlayerListsEqual(zone.CurrentBlue, blueOccupants)

		zone.CurrentRed = redOccupants
		zone.CurrentBlue = blueOccupants
		if roundService and roundService.CancelPreparationIfOccupancyLost then
			roundService:CancelPreparationIfOccupancyLost(zone.ZoneId)
		end

		-- Actualizar feedback audiovisual discreto por instancia de zona
		if feedbackService then
			feedbackService:SetPadOccupied(zoneFolder, "Red", #redOccupants > 0, redOccupants[1])
			feedbackService:SetPadOccupied(zoneFolder, "Blue", #blueOccupants > 0, blueOccupants[1])
		end

		-- Determinar candidatos comprometidos según TeamSize
		local committedRed: { Player } = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#redOccupants, zone.Config.TeamSize) do
			table.insert(committedRed, redOccupants[i])
		end
		local committedBlue: { Player } = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#blueOccupants, zone.Config.TeamSize) do
			table.insert(committedBlue, blueOccupants[i])
		end

		-- Verificar que los equipos sean disjuntos
		local disjoint = true
		for _, r in ipairs(committedRed) do
			if table.find(committedBlue, r) then
				disjoint = false
				break
			end
		end

		-- Verificar que ninguno de los participantes esté registrado en otra partida
		local anyAlreadyInMatch = false
		if roundService and roundService.GetSessionForPlayer then
			for _, p in ipairs(committedRed) do
				if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(p) ~= nil then
					anyAlreadyInMatch = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not anyAlreadyInMatch then
				for _, p in ipairs(committedBlue) do
					if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(p) ~= nil then
						anyAlreadyInMatch = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local socialPlay=self:_socialPlay()
   local groupsReady=not socialPlay or (socialPlay:CanQueueTeam(committedRed,zone.Config.TeamSize)and socialPlay:CanQueueTeam(committedBlue,zone.Config.TeamSize))
   local isReady = groupsReady and (#committedRed == zone.Config.TeamSize)
			and (#committedBlue == zone.Config.TeamSize)
			and disjoint
			and not anyAlreadyInMatch

		-- Gestionar token autoritativo de reserva
		if isReady then
			-- Comprobar si la reserva existente sigue siendo válida para la misma plantilla
			local currentRes = zone.ActiveReservation
			local needsNewRes = true
			if currentRes and (os.clock() <= currentRes.ExpiresAt) then
				if currentRes.Mode == zone.Config.Mode
					and currentRes.TeamSize == zone.Config.TeamSize
					and #currentRes.RedTeam == #committedRed
					and #currentRes.BlueTeam == #committedBlue
				then
					local matches = true
					for i = 1, #committedRed do
						if currentRes.RedTeam[i] ~= committedRed[i] then
							matches = false
							break
						end
					end
					if matches then
						for i = 1, #committedBlue do
							if currentRes.BlueTeam[i] ~= committedBlue[i] then
								matches = false
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if matches then
						needsNewRes = false
					end
				end
			end

			if needsNewRes then
				self:CreateReservation(zone.ZoneId, zone.Config.Mode, zone.Config.TeamSize, committedRed, committedBlue)
			end
		else
			-- Si no está listo, invalidar cualquier reserva previa
			zone.ActiveReservation = nil
		end

		local newState: QueueStateName = if isReady then "READY" else "WAITING"
		local stateChanged = zone.State ~= newState
		zone.State = newState

		-- Emitir QueueSnapshot cuando hay cambios o para sincronización
		if redChanged or blueChanged or stateChanged or (zone :: any).ForceSnapshot then
			(zone :: any).ForceSnapshot = nil
			local snapshot: QueueSnapshot = {
				ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
				ZoneName = zone.ZoneName,
				Mode = zone.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zone.Config.TeamSize,
				MaxPlayersPerTeam = zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
				TotalPlayers = zone.Config.TotalPlayers,
				Red = redOccupants,
				Blue = blueOccupants,
				State = newState,
			}

			self._latestSnapshots[zone.ZoneId] = snapshot
			self._latestSnapshots[zone.ZoneName] = snapshot

			if self._queueStatusRemote then
				self._queueStatusRemote:FireAllClients(snapshot)
			end
		end

		-- Disparar inicio de partida cuando la cola está lista y RoundService disponible
		if isReady and roundService and roundService:IsAvailable() then
			local token = if zone.ActiveReservation then zone.ActiveReservation.Token else nil
			local admissionRequest: Types.TeamMatchAdmissionRequest = {
				ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
				Mode = zone.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zone.Config.TeamSize,
				RedTeam = committedRed,
				BlueTeam = committedBlue,
				ReservationToken = token,
			}

			local ok, reason = roundService:StartTeamMatch(admissionRequest)
			if not ok then
				if reason == "ModeNotPlayable" then
					if zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn ~= zone.Config.Mode then
						zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn = zone.Config.Mode
						print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Modalidad '%s' en zona '%s' admitida estructuralmente pero bloqueada para juego real (ModeNotPlayable)",
							zone.Config.Mode, zone.ZoneId))
					end
				else
					-- No silenciar otros errores
				end
			else
				zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- A party remains a complete cohort on the same physical team; no remote teleports.

 for _,zone in pairs(self._zones)do
  if table.find(zone.CurrentRed,player)or table.find(zone.CurrentBlue,player)then return true end
 end
 return false
end

-- Crea una reserva autoritativa para una plantilla lista
function MatchmakingService:CreateReservation(
	zoneId: string,
	mode: string,
	teamSize: number,
	redTeam: { Player },
	blueTeam: { Player },
	ttlSeconds: number?
): Types.TeamMatchReservation?
	local targetZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			targetZone = z
			break
		end
	end
	if not targetZone then return nil end

	local ttl = ttlSeconds or (Config.Matchmaking and Config.Matchmaking.ReservationTTL) or 15
	local now = os.clock()
	local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)

	local redCopy: { Player } = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(redTeam) do table.insert(redCopy, p) end
	local blueCopy: { Player } = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(blueTeam) do table.insert(blueCopy, p) end

	local reservation: Types.TeamMatchReservation = {
		Token = token,
		ZoneId = zoneId,
		Mode = mode,
		TeamSize = teamSize,
		RedTeam = redCopy,
		BlueTeam = blueCopy,
		CreatedAt = now,
		ExpiresAt = now + ttl,
	}

	targetZone.ActiveReservation = reservation
	return reservation
end

-- Obtiene la reserva autoritativa activa de una zona
function MatchmakingService:GetActiveReservation(zoneId: string): Types.TeamMatchReservation?
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			return z.ActiveReservation
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Valida que un token corresponda exactamente a la plantilla y zona activa sin haber expirado
function MatchmakingService:ValidateReservation(
	token: string,
	request: Types.TeamMatchAdmissionRequest
): (boolean, string?)
 if type(request.ZoneId)=='string'and request.ZoneId:sub(1,5)=='Menu:'then
  local menu=self._context:GetService('PartyMatchService');return menu and menu:ValidateReservation(token,request)or false,'InvalidMenuReservation'
 end
 if type(request.ZoneId)=='string'and request.ZoneId:sub(1,5)=='Duel:'then
  local play=self:_socialPlay();if not play then return false,'SocialPlayUnavailable'end
  return play:ValidateDuel(token,request)
 end

	if not token or token == "" then
		return false, "MissingReservationToken"
	end

	local foundZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ActiveReservation and z.ActiveReservation.Token == token then
			foundZone = z
			break
		end
	end

	if not foundZone or not foundZone.ActiveReservation then
		return false, "ReservationNotFound"
	end

	local res = foundZone.ActiveReservation
	local now = os.clock()
	if now > res.ExpiresAt then
		foundZone.ActiveReservation = nil
		return false, "ReservationExpired"
	end

	if res.ZoneId ~= request.ZoneId then
		return false, "ReservationZoneMismatch"
	end

	if res.Mode ~= request.Mode then
		return false, "ReservationModeMismatch"
	end

	if res.TeamSize ~= request.TeamSize then
		return false, "ReservationTeamSizeMismatch"
	end

	if #res.RedTeam ~= #request.RedTeam or #res.BlueTeam ~= #request.BlueTeam then
		return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
	end

	for i = 1, #res.RedTeam do
		if res.RedTeam[i] ~= request.RedTeam[i] then
			return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #res.BlueTeam do
		if res.BlueTeam[i] ~= request.BlueTeam[i] then
			return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
		end
	end

	return true, nil
end

-- Consume de forma atómica una reserva al ser admitida la partida
function MatchmakingService:ConsumeReservation(token: string): boolean
 local menu=self._context and self._context:GetService('PartyMatchService');if menu and menu:ConsumeReservation(token)then return true end
 local play=self:_socialPlay();if play and play:ConsumeDuel(token)then return true end
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ActiveReservation and z.ActiveReservation.Token == token then
			z.ActiveReservation = nil
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Invalida de forma explícita la reserva de una zona
-- Preserve physical occupancy/FIFO; only invalidate this preparation's reservation.
function MatchmakingService:ReleasePreparation(zoneId: string, token: string?)
 if zoneId:sub(1,5)=='Menu:'then local menu=self._context:GetService('PartyMatchService');if menu then menu:Release(zoneId,token)end;return end
 if zoneId:sub(1,5)=='Duel:'then local play=self:_socialPlay();if play then play:ReleaseDuel(zoneId,token)end;return end
	for _,zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone.ZoneId == zoneId then
			if zone.ActiveReservation and zone.ActiveReservation.Token == token then zone.ActiveReservation = nil end
			(zone :: any).ForceSnapshot = true
			return
		end
	end
end

function MatchmakingService:InvalidateReservation(zoneId: string)
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			z.ActiveReservation = nil
			break
		end
	end
end

-- Verifica de manera server-authoritative si los jugadores siguen siendo los ocupantes registrados de su zona
function MatchmakingService:ArePlayersInZone(
	zoneId: string,
	redPlayerOrTeam: Player | { Player },
	bluePlayerOrTeam: Player | { Player },
	requirePhysical: boolean?
): boolean
	if not zoneId or not redPlayerOrTeam or not bluePlayerOrTeam then
		return false
	end

	local redList: { Player } = if typeof(redPlayerOrTeam) == "table" and not (redPlayerOrTeam :: any).IsSimulatedPlayer then (redPlayerOrTeam :: { Player }) else { redPlayerOrTeam :: Player }
	local blueList: { Player } = if typeof(bluePlayerOrTeam) == "table" and not (bluePlayerOrTeam :: any).IsSimulatedPlayer then (bluePlayerOrTeam :: { Player }) else { bluePlayerOrTeam :: Player }

	if #redList == 0 or #blueList == 0 then
		return false
	end
	if zoneId:sub(1,5)=='Menu:'then local menu=self._context:GetService('PartyMatchService');return menu~=nil and menu:Prepared(zoneId,redList,blueList)end

	for _, p in ipairs(redList) do
		if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(p) then return false end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(blueList) do
		if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(p) then return false end
	end

 if zoneId:sub(1,5)=='Duel:'then
  local play=self:_socialPlay();return play~=nil and play:DuelPrepared(zoneId,redList,blueList)
 end

	-- 1. Resolver la zona mediante ZoneId
	local targetZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone.ZoneId == zoneId then
			targetZone = zone
			break
		end
	end

	if not targetZone then
		return false
	end

	-- Verificar existencia de la instancia física
	if not targetZone.Instance or not targetZone.Instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return false
	end

	-- 2. Verificar que todos los jugadores de cada equipo están registrados en la zona
	for _, p in ipairs(redList) do
		if not table.find(targetZone.CurrentRed, p) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(blueList) do
		if not table.find(targetZone.CurrentBlue, p) then
			return false
		end
	end

	if requirePhysical then
		local params=OverlapParams.new()
		params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		local characters={}
		for _,list in ipairs({redList,blueList}) do for _,p in ipairs(list) do table.insert(characters,p.Character) end end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances=characters
		for _,entry in ipairs({{Pads=targetZone.RedPads,Players=redList},{Pads=targetZone.BluePads,Players=blueList}}) do
			local present={}
			for _,pad in ipairs(entry.Pads) do for _,p in ipairs(getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad,params)) do present[p]=true end end
			for _,p in ipairs(entry.Players) do if not present[p] then return false end end
		end
	end
	return true
end

--!strict
-- MatchmakingService
-- Gestiona la detección de jugadores en zonas de matchmaking genéricas (1v1, 2v2, 3v3),
-- construye el QueueSnapshot autoritativo, controla la capacidad por equipo y despacha
-- partidas hacia RoundService.
-- La instancia física (zoneFolder) es la identidad primaria interna de la zona.
-- NO se encarga de efectos audiovisuales (delegado a MatchmakingFeedbackService)
-- ni de la presentación visual del HUD (delegado a MatchmakingController).

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)

type QueueSnapshot = Types.QueueSnapshot
type MatchmakingZoneConfig = Types.MatchmakingZoneConfig
type QueueStateName = Types.QueueStateName

export type ZoneData = {
	ZoneId: string,
	Instance: Folder,
	ZoneName: string,
	Config: MatchmakingZoneConfig,
	RedPads: { BasePart },
	BluePads: { BasePart },
	PadOccupants: { [BasePart]: { Player } },
	OccupantLastSeen: { [Player]: number },
	CandidateArrivals: { [Player]: number },
	CandidateLastSeen: { [Player]: number },
	CurrentRed: { Player },
	CurrentBlue: { Player },
	State: QueueStateName,
	ActiveReservation: Types.TeamMatchReservation?,
	LastModeNotPlayableWarn: string?,
}

local MatchmakingService = {}
MatchmakingService.Name = "MatchmakingService"

MatchmakingService._context = nil :: any
MatchmakingService._zones = {} :: { [Folder]: ZoneData }
MatchmakingService._latestSnapshots = {} :: { [string]: QueueSnapshot }
MatchmakingService._checkConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
MatchmakingService._lastCheck = 0
MatchmakingService._queueStatusRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
MatchmakingService._containerConnections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection }
MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap = {} :: { [Model]: any }

-- Obtiene el Player asociado a una parte de un personaje
local function getPlayerFromPart(part: BasePart): Player?
	local current: Instance? = part
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		if current:IsA("Model") then
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current)
			if player then
				return player
			end
			if MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap and MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap[current] then
				return MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap[current]
			end
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT = 6.0
local OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD = 0.8 -- Segundos de gracia para tolerar saltos y fluctuaciones espaciales

-- Valida si un jugador está conectado, con personaje instanciado en workspace y Humanoid vivo
local function isPlayerAliveAndValid(player: any): boolean
	local isRealPlayer = typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") and player:IsDescendantOf(Players)
	local isSimulated = typeof(player) == "table" and player.IsSimulatedPlayer == true
	if not isRealPlayer and not isSimulated then return false end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return true
end

-- Detecta los jugadores físicos dentro del volumen de un pad usando GetPartBoundsInBox
local function getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad: BasePart, overlapParams: OverlapParams): { Player }
	local boxCFrame = pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (pad.Size.Y / 2) + (PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT / 2), 0)
	local boxSize = Vector3.new(pad.Size.X, PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT, pad.Size.Z)
	local touchingParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, boxSize, overlapParams)

	local presentList: { Player } = {}
	local seen: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

	for _, part in ipairs(touchingParts) do
		local player = getPlayerFromPart(part)
		if player and not seen[player] then
			if isPlayerAliveAndValid(player) then
				seen[player] = true
				table.insert(presentList, player)
			end
		end
	end

	return presentList
end

-- Actualiza autoritativamente la ocupación de un conjunto de pads (equipo) aplicando
-- prioridad por orden de llegada (FIFO), reserva por plaza, grace period y prevención de doble ocupación.
local function updateTeamOccupants(
	zone: ZoneData,
	pads: { BasePart },
	maxTeamCapacity: number,
	otherTeamOccupantsSet: { [Player]: boolean },
	overlapParams: OverlapParams,
	now: number,
	service: any
): { Player }
	if #pads == 0 or maxTeamCapacity <= 0 then
		return {}
	end

	local padCapacity = math.max(1, math.ceil(maxTeamCapacity / #pads))

	-- 1. Detección física en cada pad del equipo
	local presentByPad: { [BasePart]: { [Player]: boolean } } = {}
	local allPresentOnTeam: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local presentList = getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad, overlapParams)
		local padSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(presentList) do
			padSet[p] = true
			allPresentOnTeam[p] = true
		end
		presentByPad[pad] = padSet
	end

	-- 2. Retención de ocupantes existentes (con grace period)
	local assignedThisTeam: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	local teamOccupantsList: { Player } = {}

	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local currentOccupants = zone.PadOccupants[pad] or {}
		local retained: { Player } = {}
		local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}

		for _, occupant in ipairs(currentOccupants) do
			if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(occupant) then
				-- Jugador muerto o desconectado: liberación inmediata sin periodo de gracia
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
			elseif assignedThisTeam[occupant] or otherTeamOccupantsSet[occupant] then
				-- Conflicto: ya asignado a otra plaza o al equipo contrario
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
			else
				if presentSet[occupant] then
					-- Físicamente presente: retiene plaza y actualiza marca temporal
					zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = now
					assignedThisTeam[occupant] = true
					table.insert(retained, occupant)
					table.insert(teamOccupantsList, occupant)
				else
					-- Ausente físicamente en este frame: comprobar periodo de gracia (tolerancia a saltos/jitter)
					local lastSeen = zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] or 0
					if (now - lastSeen) <= OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD then
						assignedThisTeam[occupant] = true
						table.insert(retained, occupant)
						table.insert(teamOccupantsList, occupant)
					else
						-- Gracia expirada: abandono confirmado, liberar plaza
						zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
						zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
						zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		zone.PadOccupants[pad] = retained
	end

	-- 3. Registro de candidatos esperando en los pads
	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}
		for p in pairs(presentSet) do
			if not assignedThisTeam[p] and not otherTeamOccupantsSet[p] then
				if not service:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(p, zone) then
					if zone.CandidateArrivals[p] == nil then
						zone.CandidateArrivals[p] = now
					end
					zone.CandidateLastSeen[p] = now
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 4. Asignación de plazas disponibles por orden de llegada (FIFO)
	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local retained = zone.PadOccupants[pad] or {}
		local padSlotsAvailable = padCapacity - #retained
		local teamSlotsAvailable = maxTeamCapacity - #teamOccupantsList

		if padSlotsAvailable > 0 and teamSlotsAvailable > 0 then
			local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}
			local candidates: { Player } = {}

			for p in pairs(presentSet) do
				if not assignedThisTeam[p]
					and not otherTeamOccupantsSet[p]
					and not service:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(p, zone)
					and not table.find(retained, p) then
					table.insert(candidates, p)
				end
			end

			-- Ordenar candidatos por orden de llegada estricto
			table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
				local timeA = zone.CandidateArrivals[a] or math.huge
				local timeB = zone.CandidateArrivals[b] or math.huge
				if timeA == timeB then
					return a.UserId < b.UserId
				end
				return timeA < timeB
			end)

			local toAssign = math.min(padSlotsAvailable, teamSlotsAvailable, #candidates)
			for i = 1, toAssign do
				local chosen = candidates[i]
				table.insert(retained, chosen)
				table.insert(teamOccupantsList, chosen)
				assignedThisTeam[chosen] = true
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[chosen] = now
			end

			zone.PadOccupants[pad] = retained
		end
	end

	-- 5. Limpieza de candidatos que se retiraron (respetando gracia para evitar pérdida por salto)
	for candidate, lastSeen in pairs(zone.CandidateLastSeen) do
		if not allPresentOnTeam[candidate] and not assignedThisTeam[candidate] then
			if (now - lastSeen) > OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD then
				zone.CandidateArrivals[candidate] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[candidate] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	return teamOccupantsList
end

-- Attributes describe an authorized mode; they never define a new mode or its capacity.
local function getZoneConfiguration(zoneFolder: Folder): (MatchmakingZoneConfig?, string?)
	local modeAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("Mode")
	local teamSizeAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("TeamSize")
	local maxPerTeamAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("MaxPlayersPerTeam")
	local totalAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("TotalPlayers")

	local modeName = if type(modeAttr) == "string" and modeAttr ~= "" then modeAttr else zoneFolder.Name
	local configDefaults = Config.Matchmaking and Config.Matchmaking.Modes and Config.Matchmaking.Modes[modeName]

	if not configDefaults then return nil, "UnknownMode" end
	for _, entry in ipairs({
		{ Value = teamSizeAttr, Expected = configDefaults.TeamSize },
		{ Value = maxPerTeamAttr, Expected = configDefaults.MaxPlayersPerTeam },
		{ Value = totalAttr, Expected = configDefaults.TotalPlayers },
	}) do
		if entry.Value ~= nil and entry.Value ~= entry.Expected then
			return nil, "ModeCapacityMismatch"
		end
	end

	return {
		Mode = modeName,
		TeamSize = configDefaults.TeamSize,
		MaxPlayersPerTeam = configDefaults.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
		TotalPlayers = configDefaults.TotalPlayers,
	}
end

-- Verifica si un ZoneId ya está tomado por otra zona activa
function MatchmakingService:_isZoneIdTaken(zoneId: string, currentFolder: Folder): boolean
	for folder, data in pairs(self._zones) do
		if folder ~= currentFolder and data.ZoneId == zoneId then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Verifica si un jugador ya ocupa autoritativamente un pad en otra zona diferente
function MatchmakingService:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(player: Player, currentZone: ZoneData): boolean
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone ~= currentZone then
			if table.find(zone.CurrentRed, player) or table.find(zone.CurrentBlue, player) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function MatchmakingService:Init(context)
	self._context = context
	self._zones = {}
	self._latestSnapshots = {}
	self._containerConnections = {}
	_G.MatchmakingService = self

	-- Garantizar Remote de estado de cola
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local mmFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Matchmaking")
	local queueRemote = mmFolder and mmFolder:FindFirstChild("QueueStatus")
	if queueRemote and queueRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		self._queueStatusRemote = queueRemote
	end

	-- Descubrir zonas en Workspace.ZoneMatchmaking
	local zoneContainer = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneMatchmaking")
	if not zoneContainer then
		warn("[MatchmakingService] No se encontro Workspace.ZoneMatchmaking")
		return
	end

	-- Registrar todas las zonas existentes
	for _, child in ipairs(zoneContainer:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			self:_registerZone(child)
		end
	end

	-- Conectar descubrimiento dinámico en tiempo de ejecución (Runtime Add / Remove)
	table.insert(self._containerConnections, zoneContainer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			-- Dar un frame para asegurar inicialización de atributos y jerarquía en caso de clonación
			task.defer(function()
				if child.Parent == zoneContainer then
					self:_registerZone(child)
				end
			end)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(self._containerConnections, zoneContainer.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			self:_unregisterZone(child)
		end
	end))
end

function MatchmakingService:_registerZone(zoneFolder: Folder)
	if not zoneFolder or not zoneFolder:IsA("Folder") then return end
	if self._zones[zoneFolder] then return end

	local config, configError = getZoneConfiguration(zoneFolder)
	if not config then
		-- Decorative folders have no join pads and are not matchmaking zones.
		if zoneFolder:FindFirstChild("joins-parts") then
			warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': %s", zoneFolder.Name, tostring(configError)))
		end
		return
	end
	local joinsFolder = zoneFolder:FindFirstChild("joins-parts")

	local redPads: { BasePart } = {}
	local bluePads: { BasePart } = {}

	if joinsFolder then
		for _, part in ipairs(joinsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local teamAttr = part:GetAttribute("Team")
				if teamAttr == "Red" or part.Name == "Red" or part.Name:find("Red") then
					table.insert(redPads, part)
				elseif teamAttr == "Blue" or part.Name == "Blue" or part.Name:find("Blue") then
					table.insert(bluePads, part)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #redPads == 0 or #bluePads == 0 then
		warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': MissingTeamPads", zoneFolder.Name))
		return
	end
	table.sort(redPads, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	table.sort(bluePads, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)

	-- Generación de ZoneId único
	local attrId = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("ZoneId")
	local zoneId: string
	if typeof(attrId) == "string" and attrId ~= "" then
		if self:_isZoneIdTaken(attrId, zoneFolder) then
			warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': DuplicateZoneId", zoneFolder.Name))
			return
		end
		zoneId = attrId
	else
		local baseId = "Zone_" .. zoneFolder.Name
		local uniqueId = baseId
		local counter = 1
		while self:_isZoneIdTaken(uniqueId, zoneFolder) do
			counter += 1
			uniqueId = string.format("%s_%d", baseId, counter)
		end
		zoneId = uniqueId
	end

	local padOccupants: { [BasePart]: { Player } } = {}
	for _, pad in ipairs(redPads) do
		padOccupants[pad] = {}
	end
	for _, pad in ipairs(bluePads) do
		padOccupants[pad] = {}
	end

	local zoneData: ZoneData = {
		ZoneId = zoneId,
		Instance = zoneFolder,
		ZoneName = zoneFolder.Name,
		Config = config,
		RedPads = redPads,
		BluePads = bluePads,
		PadOccupants = padOccupants,
		OccupantLastSeen = {},
		CandidateArrivals = {},
		CandidateLastSeen = {},
		CurrentRed = {},
		CurrentBlue = {},
		State = "WAITING",
		ActiveReservation = nil,
		LastModeNotPlayableWarn = nil,
	}

	-- Registrar en MatchmakingFeedbackService
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	if feedbackService then
		feedbackService:RegisterZone(zoneFolder)
	end

	self._zones[zoneFolder] = zoneData
	print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona registrada: '%s' (ZoneId=%s, Modo=%s, TeamSize=%d, MaxTotal=%d)",
		zoneFolder.Name, zoneId, config.Mode, config.TeamSize, config.TotalPlayers))
end

function MatchmakingService:_unregisterZone(zoneFolder: Folder)
	local zoneData = self._zones[zoneFolder]
	if not zoneData then return end

	-- Cleanup en feedback audiovisual
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	if feedbackService then
		feedbackService:UnregisterZone(zoneFolder)
	end

	-- Emitir snapshot vacío final a los clientes si la zona tenía jugadores
	if #zoneData.CurrentRed > 0 or #zoneData.CurrentBlue > 0 then
		if self._queueStatusRemote then
			local finalSnapshot: QueueSnapshot = {
				ZoneId = zoneData.ZoneId,
				ZoneName = zoneData.ZoneName,
				Mode = zoneData.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zoneData.Config.TeamSize,
				MaxPlayersPerTeam = zoneData.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
				TotalPlayers = zoneData.Config.TotalPlayers,
				Red = {},
				Blue = {},
				State = "WAITING",
			}
			self._queueStatusRemote:FireAllClients(finalSnapshot)
		end
	end

	-- Limpieza de caché de snapshots
	self._latestSnapshots[zoneData.ZoneId] = nil
	self._latestSnapshots[zoneData.ZoneName] = nil

	-- Limpieza de tablas de ocupación
	table.clear(zoneData.PadOccupants)
	table.clear(zoneData.OccupantLastSeen)
	table.clear(zoneData.CandidateArrivals)
	table.clear(zoneData.CandidateLastSeen)
	table.clear(zoneData.CurrentRed)
	table.clear(zoneData.CurrentBlue)
	zoneData.ActiveReservation = nil

	self._zones[zoneFolder] = nil
	print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona desregistrada y limpiada: '%s' (ZoneId=%s)",
		zoneFolder.Name, zoneData.ZoneId))
end

-- Limpia de forma inmediata reservas huérfanas al desconectarse un jugador
function MatchmakingService:_handlePlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local needsUpdate = false
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		zone.OccupantLastSeen[player] = nil
		zone.CandidateArrivals[player] = nil
		zone.CandidateLastSeen[player] = nil

		for pad, occupants in pairs(zone.PadOccupants) do
			local idx = table.find(occupants, player)
			if idx then
				table.remove(occupants, idx)
				needsUpdate = true
			end
		end
	end

	if needsUpdate then
		self:_updateQueue()
	end
end

function MatchmakingService:Start(context)
	self._context = context

	-- Monitoreo de ocupación cada 0.3s
	self._checkConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - self._lastCheck < 0.3 then return end
		self._lastCheck = now
		self:_updateQueue()
	end)

	-- Limpieza inmediata cuando un jugador se desconecta del servidor
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_handlePlayerRemoving(player)
	end)

	print("[MatchmakingService] Servicio de matchmaking genérico iniciado")
end

-- Compara si dos listas de jugadores son idénticas
local function arePlayerListsEqual(a: { Player }, b: { Player }): boolean
	if #a ~= #b then return false end
	for i = 1, #a do
		if a[i] ~= b[i] then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function MatchmakingService:_updateQueue()
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	local now = os.clock()

	-- Construir lista de personajes para OverlapParams
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	local characterList = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(characterList, player.Character)
		end
	end
	if self._testCharacterMap then
		for charModel, _ in pairs(self._testCharacterMap) do
			if charModel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				table.insert(characterList, charModel)
			end
		end
	end
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = characterList

	for zoneFolder, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		-- Si la zona fue destruida o desparentada, desregistrar y omitir
		if not zoneFolder or not zoneFolder:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			self:_unregisterZone(zoneFolder)
			continue
		end

		-- Conjunto de ocupantes actuales de Blue para pasárselo a Red
		local currentBlueSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(zone.CurrentBlue) do
			currentBlueSet[p] = true
		end

		local redOccupants = updateTeamOccupants(
			zone,
			zone.RedPads,
			zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
			currentBlueSet,
			overlapParams,
			now,
			self
		)

		-- Conjunto de ocupantes actualizados de Red para pasárselo a Blue
		local currentRedSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(redOccupants) do
			currentRedSet[p] = true
		end

		local blueOccupants = updateTeamOccupants(
			zone,
			zone.BluePads,
			zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
			currentRedSet,
			overlapParams,
			now,
			self
		)

		local redChanged = not arePlayerListsEqual(zone.CurrentRed, redOccupants)
		local blueChanged = not arePlayerListsEqual(zone.CurrentBlue, blueOccupants)

		zone.CurrentRed = redOccupants
		zone.CurrentBlue = blueOccupants
		if roundService and roundService.CancelPreparationIfOccupancyLost then
			roundService:CancelPreparationIfOccupancyLost(zone.ZoneId)
		end

		-- Actualizar feedback audiovisual discreto por instancia de zona
		if feedbackService then
			feedbackService:SetPadOccupied(zoneFolder, "Red", #redOccupants > 0, redOccupants[1])
			feedbackService:SetPadOccupied(zoneFolder, "Blue", #blueOccupants > 0, blueOccupants[1])
		end

		-- Determinar candidatos comprometidos según TeamSize
		local committedRed: { Player } = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#redOccupants, zone.Config.TeamSize) do
			table.insert(committedRed, redOccupants[i])
		end
		local committedBlue: { Player } = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#blueOccupants, zone.Config.TeamSize) do
			table.insert(committedBlue, blueOccupants[i])
		end

		-- Verificar que los equipos sean disjuntos
		local disjoint = true
		for _, r in ipairs(committedRed) do
			if table.find(committedBlue, r) then
				disjoint = false
				break
			end
		end

		-- Verificar que ninguno de los participantes esté registrado en otra partida
		local anyAlreadyInMatch = false
		if roundService and roundService.GetSessionForPlayer then
			for _, p in ipairs(committedRed) do
				if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(p) ~= nil then
					anyAlreadyInMatch = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not anyAlreadyInMatch then
				for _, p in ipairs(committedBlue) do
					if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(p) ~= nil then
						anyAlreadyInMatch = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local socialPlay=self:_socialPlay()
   local groupsReady=not socialPlay or (socialPlay:CanQueueTeam(committedRed,zone.Config.TeamSize)and socialPlay:CanQueueTeam(committedBlue,zone.Config.TeamSize))
   local isReady = groupsReady and (#committedRed == zone.Config.TeamSize)
			and (#committedBlue == zone.Config.TeamSize)
			and disjoint
			and not anyAlreadyInMatch

		-- Gestionar token autoritativo de reserva
		if isReady then
			-- Comprobar si la reserva existente sigue siendo válida para la misma plantilla
			local currentRes = zone.ActiveReservation
			local needsNewRes = true
			if currentRes and (os.clock() <= currentRes.ExpiresAt) then
				if currentRes.Mode == zone.Config.Mode
					and currentRes.TeamSize == zone.Config.TeamSize
					and #currentRes.RedTeam == #committedRed
					and #currentRes.BlueTeam == #committedBlue
				then
					local matches = true
					for i = 1, #committedRed do
						if currentRes.RedTeam[i] ~= committedRed[i] then
							matches = false
							break
						end
					end
					if matches then
						for i = 1, #committedBlue do
							if currentRes.BlueTeam[i] ~= committedBlue[i] then
								matches = false
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if matches then
						needsNewRes = false
					end
				end
			end

			if needsNewRes then
				self:CreateReservation(zone.ZoneId, zone.Config.Mode, zone.Config.TeamSize, committedRed, committedBlue)
			end
		else
			-- Si no está listo, invalidar cualquier reserva previa
			zone.ActiveReservation = nil
		end

		local newState: QueueStateName = if isReady then "READY" else "WAITING"
		local stateChanged = zone.State ~= newState
		zone.State = newState

		-- Emitir QueueSnapshot cuando hay cambios o para sincronización
		if redChanged or blueChanged or stateChanged or (zone :: any).ForceSnapshot then
			(zone :: any).ForceSnapshot = nil
			local snapshot: QueueSnapshot = {
				ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
				ZoneName = zone.ZoneName,
				Mode = zone.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zone.Config.TeamSize,
				MaxPlayersPerTeam = zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
				TotalPlayers = zone.Config.TotalPlayers,
				Red = redOccupants,
				Blue = blueOccupants,
				State = newState,
			}

			self._latestSnapshots[zone.ZoneId] = snapshot
			self._latestSnapshots[zone.ZoneName] = snapshot

			if self._queueStatusRemote then
				self._queueStatusRemote:FireAllClients(snapshot)
			end
		end

		-- Disparar inicio de partida cuando la cola está lista y RoundService disponible
		if isReady and roundService and roundService:IsAvailable() then
			local token = if zone.ActiveReservation then zone.ActiveReservation.Token else nil
			local admissionRequest: Types.TeamMatchAdmissionRequest = {
				ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
				Mode = zone.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zone.Config.TeamSize,
				RedTeam = committedRed,
				BlueTeam = committedBlue,
				ReservationToken = token,
			}

			local ok, reason = roundService:StartTeamMatch(admissionRequest)
			if not ok then
				if reason == "ModeNotPlayable" then
					if zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn ~= zone.Config.Mode then
						zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn = zone.Config.Mode
						print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Modalidad '%s' en zona '%s' admitida estructuralmente pero bloqueada para juego real (ModeNotPlayable)",
							zone.Config.Mode, zone.ZoneId))
					end
				else
					-- No silenciar otros errores
				end
			else
				zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

 for _,zone in pairs(self._zones)do

 end
 return false
