-- Crea una reserva autoritativa para una plantilla lista
function MatchmakingService:CreateReservation(
	zoneId: string,
	mode: string,
	teamSize: number,
	redTeam: { Player },
	blueTeam: { Player },
	ttlSeconds: number?
): Types.TeamMatchReservation?
	local targetZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			targetZone = z
			break
		end
	end
	if not targetZone then return nil end

	local ttl = ttlSeconds or (Config.Matchmaking and Config.Matchmaking.ReservationTTL) or 15
	local now = os.clock()
	local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)

	local redCopy: { Player } = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(redTeam) do table.insert(redCopy, p) end
	local blueCopy: { Player } = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(blueTeam) do table.insert(blueCopy, p) end

	local reservation: Types.TeamMatchReservation = {
		Token = token,
		ZoneId = zoneId,
		Mode = mode,
		TeamSize = teamSize,
		RedTeam = redCopy,
		BlueTeam = blueCopy,
		CreatedAt = now,
		ExpiresAt = now + ttl,
	}

	targetZone.ActiveReservation = reservation
	return reservation
end

-- Obtiene la reserva autoritativa activa de una zona
function MatchmakingService:GetActiveReservation(zoneId: string): Types.TeamMatchReservation?
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			return z.ActiveReservation
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Valida que un token corresponda exactamente a la plantilla y zona activa sin haber expirado
function MatchmakingService:ValidateReservation(
	token: string,
	request: Types.TeamMatchAdmissionRequest
): (boolean, string?)
 if type(request.ZoneId)=='string'and request.ZoneId:sub(1,5)=='Duel:'then
  local play=self:_socialPlay();if not play then return false,'SocialPlayUnavailable'end
  return play:ValidateDuel(token,request)
 end

	if not token or token == "" then
		return false, "MissingReservationToken"
	end

	local foundZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ActiveReservation and z.ActiveReservation.Token == token then
			foundZone = z
			break
		end
	end

	if not foundZone or not foundZone.ActiveReservation then
		return false, "ReservationNotFound"
	end

	local res = foundZone.ActiveReservation
	local now = os.clock()
	if now > res.ExpiresAt then
		foundZone.ActiveReservation = nil
		return false, "ReservationExpired"
	end

	if res.ZoneId ~= request.ZoneId then
		return false, "ReservationZoneMismatch"
	end

	if res.Mode ~= request.Mode then
		return false, "ReservationModeMismatch"
	end

	if res.TeamSize ~= request.TeamSize then
		return false, "ReservationTeamSizeMismatch"
	end

	if #res.RedTeam ~= #request.RedTeam or #res.BlueTeam ~= #request.BlueTeam then
		return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
	end

	for i = 1, #res.RedTeam do
		if res.RedTeam[i] ~= request.RedTeam[i] then
			return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #res.BlueTeam do
		if res.BlueTeam[i] ~= request.BlueTeam[i] then
			return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
		end
	end

	return true, nil
end

-- Consume de forma atómica una reserva al ser admitida la partida
function MatchmakingService:ConsumeReservation(token: string): boolean
 local play=self:_socialPlay();if play and play:ConsumeDuel(token)then return true end
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ActiveReservation and z.ActiveReservation.Token == token then
			z.ActiveReservation = nil
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Invalida de forma explícita la reserva de una zona
-- Preserve physical occupancy/FIFO; only invalidate this preparation's reservation.
function MatchmakingService:ReleasePreparation(zoneId: string, token: string?)
 if zoneId:sub(1,5)=='Duel:'then local play=self:_socialPlay();if play then play:ReleaseDuel(zoneId,token)end;return end
	for _,zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone.ZoneId == zoneId then
			if zone.ActiveReservation and zone.ActiveReservation.Token == token then zone.ActiveReservation = nil end
			(zone :: any).ForceSnapshot = true
			return
		end
	end
end

function MatchmakingService:InvalidateReservation(zoneId: string)
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			z.ActiveReservation = nil
			break
		end
	end
end

-- Verifica de manera server-authoritative si los jugadores siguen siendo los ocupantes registrados de su zona
function MatchmakingService:ArePlayersInZone(
	zoneId: string,
	redPlayerOrTeam: Player | { Player },
	bluePlayerOrTeam: Player | { Player },
	requirePhysical: boolean?
): boolean
	if not zoneId or not redPlayerOrTeam or not bluePlayerOrTeam then
		return false
	end

	local redList: { Player } = if typeof(redPlayerOrTeam) == "table" and not (redPlayerOrTeam :: any).IsSimulatedPlayer then (redPlayerOrTeam :: { Player }) else { redPlayerOrTeam :: Player }
	local blueList: { Player } = if typeof(bluePlayerOrTeam) == "table" and not (bluePlayerOrTeam :: any).IsSimulatedPlayer then (bluePlayerOrTeam :: { Player }) else { bluePlayerOrTeam :: Player }

	if #redList == 0 or #blueList == 0 then
		return false
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(redList) do
		if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(p) then return false end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(blueList) do
		if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(p) then return false end
	end

 if zoneId:sub(1,5)=='Duel:'then
  local play=self:_socialPlay();return play~=nil and play:DuelPrepared(zoneId,redList,blueList)
 end

	-- 1. Resolver la zona mediante ZoneId
	local targetZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone.ZoneId == zoneId then
			targetZone = zone
			break
		end
	end

	if not targetZone then
		return false
	end

	-- Verificar existencia de la instancia física
	if not targetZone.Instance or not targetZone.Instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return false
	end

	-- 2. Verificar que todos los jugadores de cada equipo están registrados en la zona
	for _, p in ipairs(redList) do
		if not table.find(targetZone.CurrentRed, p) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(blueList) do
		if not table.find(targetZone.CurrentBlue, p) then
			return false
		end
	end

	if requirePhysical then
		local params=OverlapParams.new()
		params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		local characters={}
		for _,list in ipairs({redList,blueList}) do for _,p in ipairs(list) do table.insert(characters,p.Character) end end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances=characters
		for _,entry in ipairs({{Pads=targetZone.RedPads,Players=redList},{Pads=targetZone.BluePads,Players=blueList}}) do
			local present={}
			for _,pad in ipairs(entry.Pads) do for _,p in ipairs(getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad,params)) do present[p]=true end end
			for _,p in ipairs(entry.Players) do if not present[p] then return false end end
		end
	end
	return true
end

--!strict
-- Bootstrap
-- Punto de entrada del servidor. Requiere los servicios, ejecuta Init() y Start()
-- en orden controlado, y maneja errores de inicializacion de forma clara.

local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local ServicesFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Services", 10)
assert(ServicesFolder, "[Bootstrap] No se encontro ServerScriptService.Services")

local PersistenceFolder = ServicesFolder:WaitForChild("Persistence", 10)
assert(PersistenceFolder, "[Bootstrap] No se encontro ServerScriptService.Services.Persistence")
local PersistenceEnvironment = require(PersistenceFolder:WaitForChild("PersistenceEnvironment"))
local persistenceSelection = PersistenceEnvironment.Resolve()

print(string.format(
	"[Bootstrap] PersistenceEnvironment=%s PersistenceProvider=%s WritesToCloud=%s GameId=%d PlaceId=%d",
	persistenceSelection.Environment,
	persistenceSelection.ProviderName,
	tostring(persistenceSelection.WritesToCloud),
	persistenceSelection.GameId,
	persistenceSelection.PlaceId
))
if persistenceSelection.BlockedReason then
	warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Persistencia bloqueada de forma segura: %s", persistenceSelection.BlockedReason))
end

-- Seal the approved ability catalog before ShopService builds its products.
-- Publish physical Slap metadata/previews before any service requires the shared Catalog.
require(ServicesFolder:WaitForChild('Crates'):WaitForChild('SlapResourceRegistry')).Publish()
-- Only direct, explicitly named ModuleScripts are eligible for require.
local abilityFolder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild("Abilities")
local AbilityRegistry = require(ServicesFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityRegistry"))
local AbilityAssets = require(abilityFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityAssetValidator"))
AbilityRegistry.Initialize({
 Manifest = require(abilityFolder:WaitForChild("AbilityManifest")),
 DefaultId = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.AbilityDefinitions).DefaultId,
 Resolve = function(name)
  local found
  for _,child in ipairs(abilityFolder:GetChildren()) do
   if child.Name == name then
    assert(found == nil, "AmbiguousAbilityModule: " .. name)
    found = child
   end
  end
  return found
 end,
 IsModule = function(value) return value:IsA("ModuleScript") and value.Parent == abilityFolder end,
 Load = require,
 HasDependency = function(name)
  local dependency = abilityFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
  return name == "MovementGuard" and dependency ~= nil and dependency:IsA("ModuleScript")
 end,
 CheckAssets = function(assets)
  return AbilityAssets.Validate(assets, game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("AbilityEffects"))
 end,
 Warn = warn,
})

-- Orden de carga controlado. Cada servicio expone Name, Init(context) y Start(context).
local SERVICE_ORDER = {
	"PlayerDataService",
	"PlayerService",
	"ShopService",
	"RagdollService",
	"MatchInstanceService",
	"DisappearingPlatformsService",
	"SpawnService",
	"PointFeedbackService",
	"PointEffectTestService",
	"ScoreService",
	"RoundService",
	"MatchmakingFeedbackService",
	"MatchmakingService",
	"CombatService",
	"KnockbackService",
	"EliminationService",
	"DeathEffectService",
	"SlapService",
	"AbilityService",
	"CrateService",
	"ProgressionService",
	"BackSlapService",
	"CoinShopAccessService",
	"PremiumShopService",
	"SocialPlayService",
	"PartyMatchService",
	"SocialService",
	"TrainingService",
	"AdminService",
}

local loadedServices: { [string]: any } = {}
local initializedServices = {}

-- Carga de modulos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local moduleScript = ServicesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicio no encontrado o invalido: %s", name))
		continue
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error al requerir %s: %s", name, tostring(result)))
		continue
	end

	loadedServices[name] = result
end

-- Contexto compartido: permite referencias controladas sin dependencias circulares.
local context = {
	Services = loadedServices,
	PersistenceProvider = persistenceSelection.Provider,
	PersistenceInfo = persistenceSelection,
	GetService = function(_self, name: string)
		return loadedServices[name]
	end,
}

-- Init() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Init) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Init(context)
		end)
		if ok then
			table.insert(initializedServices, name)
		else
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Init() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Init()", name))
	end
end

-- Start() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Start) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Start(context)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Start() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Start()", name))
	end
end

print(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicios inicializados: %s", table.concat(initializedServices, ", ")))
print("[Bootstrap] Arranque completado")

-- Orden de carga controlado. Cada servicio expone Name, Init(context) y Start(context).
local SERVICE_ORDER = {
	"PlayerDataService",
	"PlayerService",
	"ShopService",
	"RagdollService",
	"MatchInstanceService",
	"DisappearingPlatformsService",
	"SpawnService",
	"PointFeedbackService",
	"PointEffectTestService",
	"ScoreService",
	"RoundService",
	"MatchmakingFeedbackService",
	"MatchmakingService",
	"CombatService",
	"KnockbackService",
	"EliminationService",
	"DeathEffectService",
	"SlapService",
	"AbilityService",
	"CrateService",
	"ProgressionService",
	"BackSlapService",
	"CoinShopAccessService",
	"PremiumShopService",
	"SocialPlayService",
	"SocialService",
	"TrainingService",
	"AdminService",
}

local loadedServices: { [string]: any } = {}
local initializedServices = {}

-- Carga de modulos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local moduleScript = ServicesFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicio no encontrado o invalido: %s", name))
		continue
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleScript)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error al requerir %s: %s", name, tostring(result)))
		continue
	end

	loadedServices[name] = result
end

-- Contexto compartido: permite referencias controladas sin dependencias circulares.
local context = {
	Services = loadedServices,
	PersistenceProvider = persistenceSelection.Provider,
	PersistenceInfo = persistenceSelection,
	GetService = function(_self, name: string)
		return loadedServices[name]
	end,
}

-- Init() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Init) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Init(context)
		end)
		if ok then
			table.insert(initializedServices, name)
		else
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Init() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Init()", name))
	end
end

-- Start() en todos
for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
	local service = loadedServices[name]
	if not service then
		continue
	end

	if type(service.Start) == "function" then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			service:Start(context)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] Error en Start() de %s: %s", name, tostring(err)))
		end
	else
		warn(string.format("[Bootstrap] %s no implementa Start()", name))
	end
end

print(string.format("[Bootstrap] Servicios inicializados: %s", table.concat(initializedServices, ", ")))
print("[Bootstrap] Arranque completado")
